en.title: Perimeter of a Single Island
en.description:
0 is water and 1 is land. Land cells connected 4-directionally form exactly one island with no lakes, surrounded by water. Each cell has side length 1. Find the perimeter of the island.

This site independently wrote the standard I/O, examples, solution, and tests.
en.input: The first line contains N M (1..100), followed by N lines each with M values 0/1. There is guaranteed to be exactly one island and no inner lakes.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation:
Example 1: a single cell has four sides, so the perimeter is 4.

Example 2: a solid 2×2 square has sides of length 2, so the perimeter is 8.

Example 3: three cells contribute 12, minus 4 for the two shared edges, giving a perimeter of 8.
hints: Each land cell contributes 4 to start with, and each edge shared with a land cell above or to the left subtracts 2.
